settings.text: Around 40 years ago, Indian Rug Store started in Jaipur, where tourists visiting the Pink City often discovered our handmade rug collection and purchased rugs directly from our store. Since we were also the manufacturers, customers trusted the quality and craftsmanship of our products. After returning home, many of them placed custom rug orders with us and referred our rugs to their friends and families. Over the years, this trust and word-of-mouth support helped us grow into a strong global customer base, especially in the United States.

At Indian Rug Store create premium luxury handmade rugs that transform spaces into timeless expressions of beauty and comfort. Every rug we craft carries the soul of skilled artisans and the richness of traditional craftsmanship. We aim to blend heritage with modern elegance, offering pieces that elevate interiors while telling a meaningful story. By preserving the ancient art of handweaving, we keep generations of craftsmanship alive. We believe true luxury lies in authenticity, quality, and human touch. Through ethical practices and dedication to excellence, we bring artistry from the loom to homes around the world. Each rug we deliver is not just décor — it is tradition, passion, and legacy woven together.

settings.title: OUR PEOPLE
settings.text: At Indian Rug Store, we believe in the power of giving back. We actively support our community through charitable initiatives and partnerships, empowering those in need. Our commitment to making a positive impact extends beyond our products, enriching lives and fostering growth.

settings.title: OUR ENVIRONMENT
settings.text: At Indian Rug Store, we are dedicated to protecting our planet. We prioritize sustainable practices in every step of our production process, using eco-friendly materials and reducing waste. Our commitment to the environment ensures that beauty and responsibility go hand in hand.

Consider us your go-to destination for the latest trends and carefully crafted designs that speak to every style. Our curated collection of beautiful rugs features handmade, washable, custom, and more — all thoughtfully designed to offer both beauty and function. Whether you're a minimalist or a maximalist, our rugs are made to complement your space and lifestyle for years to come. Explore our collection and find the perfect foundation for your home.

Consider us as your provider of unique artworks, where imagination blends with craftsmanship. Our collection is carefully curated handmade art, each piece ranging from abstract to traditional with meticulous detail and passion. It is a unique statement or elegant touch that enhances your space for the years to come. Find that special artwork to not only adorn your home but also tell your unique story.

We at Indian Rug Store believe that luxury must be made accessible. With the essence of combining quality over time and the value to spend money for an update on any purchase, our pieces assure not sacrificing fashion for handiwork and vice versa. Using high-grade eco-friendly materials and precision care to every handcraft piece creates true, timeless beauty in your abode, and these updates enhance every aspect with sophistication and poise. Perfectly poised in both value and style

settings.heading: WHY SHOP AT INDIAN RUG STORE

settings.text: At India Rug Store, we provide high-quality, handcrafted rugs with the authentic Indian artisanship in every single one of them. We make each rug out of premium wool, silk, and cotton to assure durability and luxury. Our collection encompasses various styles ranging from traditional to contemporary designs and can suit any space, all while providing products that are both eco-friendly and sustainable. We have competitive prices, personalized services, and a customer satisfaction guarantee; thus, shopping will be easy for you and allow you to find that perfect rug that would complement your home or office.

It's where magic happens. Spinning fibers with expertise and finesse, making each strand a masterpiece to be woven, makes for a thread of great quality that can really add vibrancy to intricate designs. The key transformation of raw materials into good quality threads begins at this crucial stage. Our careful attention creates the foundation for every beautiful rug and lays down the ground for the excellence to be followed through.

Experience the explosion of colors with thread dyeing where colors come alive. Each thread is hand-dyed with precision into rich hues, making the richness of our rugs beautiful. Having bold dynamic tones to soft and subtle shades in dyes can be your guarantee in every weave for lasting brilliance. Experience the magic behind color transforming ordinary threads into masterpieces.

Timeless rug weaving speaks of stories and every thread having a tale of its own, all woven to create a wonderful warm character by skill and passion. From great vibrant patterns and intricate designs that give each of the pieces so much character that blend tradition and modern elegance and go into worlds of craftsmanship with luxury in each knotted fibre.

The delicate art of rug washing: experience how the threads are delicately cleaned to unveil the real beauty hidden in them. This step of the manufacturing process adds a finishing touch that gives each rug an enhanced texture, making it softer and brighter. Gentle washing allows for depth of color to shine through while softening the fibers, providing a perfect finish. It's a final touch that makes a beautiful rug turn into a masterpiece.

Clipping is a magic technique with the finishing result of each and every rug. It's where the artisans shape the rugs at clean lines that will create precision on a flat surface. A very important element for making designs of a rug polished, which adds an ideal, perfect definition. In our process of adding those perfect clippings on your rug, its beauty lives, with all those minute yet necessary finishing touches.

Where India’s Heritage Meets World-Class Luxury

Step into the world of Indian Rug Store, a global name synonymous with legacy, artistry, and uncompromising excellence. For more than three remarkable decades, we have stood at the forefront of India’s rug-making tradition—preserving its ancient soul while redefining its future.

Founded in 1992, our journey began with a powerful vision: to safeguard one of India’s oldest artistic traditions and share it with the world. From our home in the heart of India—surrounded by centuries of culture, color, and craftsmanship—we set out to create rugs that are not merely pieces of décor, but masterpieces of heritage.

A Legacy of Master Craftsmanship

At Indian Rug Store, craftsmanship is not just part of what we do—

it is who we are.

Every rug we create is a living story, meticulously hand-woven by master artisans whose skills have been refined through generations. Using time-honored techniques passed down for centuries, they transform the purest wool, the finest silk, and the most exquisite natural fibers into works of art.

From the royal patterns of Kashmir, to the vibrant palettes of Rajasthan, to the timeless motifs cherished across India, each design captures a fragment of our nation’s cultural soul. Every knot, every thread, and every detail is crafted with unwavering precision.

Quality Without Compromise

We believe true luxury begins with authenticity.

That is why we commit ourselves to the highest standards of quality at every step.


  • Finest natural materials sourced with care

  • Exquisite hand craftsmanship guided by tradition

  • Stringent quality controls at every stage

  • Durability and elegance that last for generations

Our rugs are created to endure—becoming heirlooms, statements of style, and treasures that elevate any space, from modern residences to palatial interiors.

Guardians of Tradition. Innovators of the Future.

While we honor the traditions that define us, we are equally driven by a passion for innovation. At Indian Rug Store, we continually evolve—introducing new designs, exploring modern techniques, and embracing sustainable, responsible practices.

Our mission is not only to create extraordinary rugs, but to uplift the communities and artisans who bring them to life, ensuring this ancient craft thrives for generations to come.

Experience the Soul of India, Woven Into Every Thread

Indian Rug Store is more than a brand—it is a celebration of India’s artistic heritage and a testament to the timeless beauty of handcrafted excellence.

We invite you to discover a world where

the past meets the present, art meets luxury, and every rug tells a story of majesty and tradition.

Welcome to Indian Rug Store—where craftsmanship becomes legacy, and legacy becomes art.
